steps.text: 8:36 P.M. \ Rainy \ Visibility: 12 km
Rhodes Island

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Welcome back.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I already heard what happened from the recon squad.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, let me check your hands.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's no need for that, Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...All right.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It looks fine. The rings haven't cracked or discolored.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But it might be different next time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Listen closely, Amiya...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Be a little more careful.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, I...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I need some rest.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Never put Amiya in this much risk again.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You are also responsible for what happened.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When you first came back to Rhodes Island, she looked a bit like this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: These emotions never really left Amiya.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This has to change.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Dr. {@nickname}, you should stay with her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't mess up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's open.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Worried? I am?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...You saw right through me, hehe...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I thought I did a good job hiding it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, I'm a bit worried... just a little, though.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm already used to doing this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After all, I can't drag down everyone else any more.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right, Doctor?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I don't understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... I don't understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, I... I know what we're trying to do. I also know... that some sacrifices are inevitable.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I... what I don't know is...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why must I watch people disappear before my eyes one by one... even though they can be saved?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We were so close... Maybe just a little bit more...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know that I have a duty... and I will continue to move forward...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But right now... I just feel so tired.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please let me have some time alone, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Good morning, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, Dr. Kal'tsit, you're here as well?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I have a rather urgent mission here, and need some people to help out.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: An abandoned city was discovered not far from Lungmen.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I surmise that it's one of the cities that formed in the aftermath of the Chernobog incident.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We'll have to explore that city, uncover more information, and search for any survivors.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If the situation is particularly serious, for example, if Reunion is hiding there, then there may be serious ramifications on our future operations.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Here's the specific proposal that I have in mind. Look over it when you have time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Oh, one more thing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Franka submitted a report to me mentioning that they had to return to Blacksteel.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As for the situation in the Lungmen slums, Penguin Logistics requested for you to meet them there to discuss some information.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There are some more sensitive details, so it'd be best for you to go in person.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know. I'll head over right now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, let's go--

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I still have some things to discuss with Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: May I listen in?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You may not.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can cover my ears...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You cannot. You should get going.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Aww...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit, you're not allowed to bully Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I won't.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You couldn't even do something so basic.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Forget it, I had a feeling this would happen.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya is an incredibly resilient kid.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But, if she has to force herself to be strong, there will come a day when the pressure breaks her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do not let this happen.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If there is a next time, you'd better be a little more useful.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What's with that face?

options: Excuse me, but what do you mean by Amiya's rings...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's related to the state of her health.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If Amiya is involved in an intense battle...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...You must check her rings immediately afterwards.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No matter what changes you see, you must report them to me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: For the time being, that's all you're allowed to know.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Oh, right. You have to go down to the medical center in two days to have a physical done. Don't forget it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...You can go. Liskarm is waiting outside to escort you.
